name: @stevenvo780/st-cli
description: ST — proof assistant CLI powered by @stevenvo780/st-lang. Commands: check, derive, countermodel, formalize, export, repl.

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p='dist/index.js'; const c=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf-8'); if(!c.startsWith('#!/usr/bin/env node')) fs.writeFileSync(p,'#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+c); require('fs').chmodSync(p,'755');"
